content:
Track: SQL Fundamentals
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Relational Databases and SQL Basics
    - Lesson 2: SQL Data Manipulation Language (DML) - SELECT Statement
    - Lesson 3: WHERE Clause and Filtering Data
    - Lesson 4: ORDER BY and Sorting Results
    - Lesson 5: JOIN Operations - Inner, Outer, Left, Right Joins
    - Lesson 6: NULL Values and Handling Missing Data
    - Lesson 7: Advanced SQL Aggregation Functions (AVG, SUM, COUNT)
    - Lesson 8: Subqueries and Nested Queries
    - Lesson 9: Views and Temporary Tables
    - Lesson 10: Writing Efficient SQL Queries for Performance

   Track: Python for Data Analysis
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Python and Jupyter Notebook
    - Lesson 2: Basic Python Syntax and Control Structures
    - Lesson 3: NumPy Library - Arrays, Matrices, and Functions
    - Lesson 4: Pandas Library - Data Frames, Series, and Indexing
    - Lesson 5: Data Cleaning Techniques (Handling Missing Values, Duplicates, Outliers)
    - Lesson 6: Data Manipulation with Pandas (Merging, Grouping, Reshaping)
    - Lesson 7: Introduction to Matplotlib for Visualization
    - Lesson 8: Intermediate Matplotlib and Customizing Plots
    - Lesson 9: Reading and Writing CSV and SQL Databases with Pandas
    - Lesson 10: Best Practices for Data Analysis in Python

   Track: Introduction to Data Cleaning
    - Lesson 1: Data Quality and Importance of Data Cleaning
    - Lesson 2: Handling Missing Values (Imputation, Deletion)
    - Lesson 3: Removing Duplicates and Outliers
    - Lesson 4: Standardizing and Normalizing Data
    - Lesson 5: Data Integration and Merging Datasets
    - Lesson 6: Handling Inconsistent or Erroneous Data
    - Lesson 7: Data Transformation Techniques (Encoding Categorical Variables)
    - Lesson 8: Dimensionality Reduction (Principal Component Analysis, Factor Analysis)
    - Lesson 9: Data Balancing for Imbalanced Classes (Oversampling, Undersampling)
    - Lesson 10: Review and Final Project on Data Cleaning Techniques

   Track: Statistics for Data Analysts
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Probability Theory
    - Lesson 2: Descriptive Statistics (Mean, Median, Mode, Standard Deviation)
    - Lesson 3: Central Limit Theorem and Sampling Distributions
    - Lesson 4: Hypothesis Testing - One-Sample t-Test
    - Lesson 5: Hypothesis Testing - Two-Sample t-Test
    - Lesson 6: Correlation and Covariance Analysis
    - Lesson 7: Linear Regression Analysis (Simple, Multiple)
    - Lesson 8: Chi-Square Test for Independence
    - Lesson 9: ANOVA (Analysis of Variance)
    - Lesson 10: Confidence Intervals and Margin of Error

   Track: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) with Python
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to EDA and its Importance
    - Lesson 2: Univariate Analysis using Seaborn Library
    - Lesson 3: Bivariate Analysis using Scatterplots, Histograms, and Box Plots
    - Lesson 4: Multivariate Analysis using Heatmaps and Correlation Matrices
    - Lesson 5: Time Series Analysis with Line Plots and Autocorrelation Functions
    - Lesson 6: Data Visualization Best Practices for EDA
    - Lesson 7: Aggregating, Grouping, and Pivoting Data for EDA
    - Lesson 8: Creating Interactive Dashboards for EDA with Bokeh or Plotly
    - Lesson 9: Exploring Categorical Data using Count Plots and Bar Charts
    - Lesson 10: Real-World Case Study on EDA with a Dataset of Your Choice
